title: Daisenryaku: Strong Style
overview: Daisenryaku: Strong Style is a hex-based war strategy game and part of the long-running Daisenryaku series. As usual for the franchise, the game includes ground, air, and naval units, and up to five armies can fight on a given map. There is both a campaign mode where the player selects from two different missions for each stage, as well as a single map mode with 16 different scenarios. In addition, the game includes a map editor, numerous assist options meant to ease in strategy game beginners, and even a unit model viewer.
